title: Induced quantum gravity from QFT vector models
abstract: QFT vector models are a newly developed approach to quantum gravity, which are based on induced gravity in discrete spacetimes. Here we review some basic definitions and properties of these models and point out directions for future research.
key_claims: Short review/proceedings of the QFT vector model approach to quantum gravity (induced gravity in discrete spacetimes)
